services.desc: Two-hour afternoon sailing with complimentary pizza, wine, beer on tap and soft drinks while enjoying Monterey Bay views. 2 Hours • Great for the whole family!

services.desc: Morning champagne brunch cruise with pastries, coffee, juice and wildlife viewing aboard the Chardonnay II. 2 Hours • Cruise around in luxury!

quotes.author: Excellent sail
quotes.text: Wonderful crew, Our Orthodontic Team s Doctors went out on the sail as a team-building event. It turned out perfect we had the best time on the water together. I would recommend it for a large or small group. I want to do it again with my family. Highly recommend the sail.

quotes.author: Sunset cruise
quotes.text: These folks go out of their way to make you feel safe and comfortable during these trying Covid times. I totally felt safe. Then the added fun of just has a great fun crew. We had great weather and water. It also helped of in the distant we whale breaching.

Celebrated my birthday with friends on the BYO night. It was lovely! Vitamin sea, great music, great views, friendly and fun staff! It’s my second time sailing with them and will continue to book with them! It’s great for any occasion!

quotes.author: Had a blast
quotes.text: We had so much fun got to see wildlife. The captain and his crew were awesome. it was a beautiful sunny day. It was safe and kid friendly. The captain let my niece steer the wheel all by herself it was one of her "best day, ever"!

We had so much fun, the weather was perfect and the crew couldn't have been better!! We went for a birthday and were able to spend time together and the kids were excited to "drive" the boat. We will definitely be back again!
